title: cheilanthes cretacea
intro: Cheilanthes cretacea, commonly known as the Foothill Lip Fern, is a type of fern species native to the southwestern United States. It is known for its edible and medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes cretacea include its ability to act as a hemostatic, helping to stop bleeding, and its potential use as an anti-ulcer agent to protect the stomach lining. The bioactive constituents of Cheilanthes cretacea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
